source_policy: Primary papers or official model repositories only; no Kaggle rules recheck in this task.

sources.title: MRNet: Deep-learning-assisted diagnosis for knee MRI
sources.use: Pretrained slice encoding, slice pooling and multi-plane fusion motivate a simple knee-MRI baseline.
sources.limit: Three original tasks and different population; not evidence of current twelve-target superiority.

sources.title: Attention-based Deep Multiple Instance Learning
sources.use: Learnable bag attention is a candidate aggregation mechanism.
sources.limit: Attention is not validated clinical localization.

sources.title: DINOv2 official model card
sources.use: ViT-S/14 has a 384-dimensional representation; fourteen-pixel patches constrain input dimensions.
sources.limit: General image features; model-specific eligibility must be verified separately.

sources.title: A ConvNet for the 2020s
sources.limit: Natural-image results do not establish knee transfer performance.

sources.title: Med3D: Transfer Learning for 3D Medical Image Analysis
sources.use: Medical 3D transfer learning motivates a bounded 3D challenger.
sources.limit: Does not establish superiority against the proposed 2D setup.

sources.title: MedicalNet official implementation
sources.limit: No weights downloaded; exact checkpoint/license/data provenance and eligibility remain a pre-acquisition check.

sources.title: CheXpert: A Large Chest Radiograph Dataset with Uncertainty Labels and Expert Comparison
sources.use: Uncertainty-label strategies can differ by pathology.
sources.limit: Chest findings do not justify importing an uncertainty policy into knees.

sources.title: Asymmetric Loss for Multi-Label Classification
sources.use: Asymmetric positive/negative treatment is a later loss ablation.
sources.limit: Benefit not established for our severe positive and negative scarcity.

sources.title: Positive-Unlabeled Learning with Non-Negative Risk Estimator
sources.use: A positive-unlabeled estimator needs defensible modeling/sampling assumptions.
sources.limit: The paper does not validate report omission as an appropriate unlabeled-data mechanism here.
